title: Dirty Region Planner
description: The Study Buddy's round 360 x 360 display is split into five regions: status bar, time, mascot, spectrum and agent message. Redrawing the whole screen sends 259,200 bytes; redrawing all five regions sends 50,752. The dirty-region rule says a region is redrawn only when the content shown in it changes.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Study Buddy
Drawing Directly to Display Regions
Dirty Region
Region Layout

Display Bandwidth

learningObjectives: The learner will apply the dirty-region rule to 6 device events by selecting exactly the regions that must be redrawn for each, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: dirty region, region layout, direct region write (all defined in the sections above this block, including the five regions in the table "Region Layout").

accessibility.notes: describe() provides a screen-reader description; all controls are native HTML elements.

userInterface.layoutPattern: drawing region above a control region

controls.name: Redraw checkboxes
controls.purpose: Tick each region whose content changes for the event shown. Leave all unticked if nothing changes.

controls.name: Submit
controls.purpose: Check your selection. One attempt per event.

controls.name: Next event / See score
controls.purpose: Move to the next event, or see the score after event 6.

controls.name: Start over
controls.purpose: Return to event 1 with a fresh score.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore, then fixed-order practice items with one attempt each and immediate explained feedback
keyQuestions: Which event sent no bytes at all, and why is that still a correct "redraw"?
Event 5 is the most expensive. What fraction of a full frame does it cost?
Why is redrawing every region on every frame a waste even though it is 4.6 times cheaper than a full frame?
commonMisconceptions: (1) Any event requires a full-screen redraw. (2) A region should be redrawn on every frame whether or not its content changed. (3) Changing the mascot's pose does not require redrawing the mascot region.
assessmentOpportunities: Complete all six events. Mastery is 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.
